chapter: Sideman years: J.J., Tyree Glenn, Sweets
title: Scandinavian tour with J.J.: 50,000 in Stockholm
summary: The tour began in Copenhagen, drew 50,000 to the Kungstradgarden in Stockholm, and lasted three months from Lapland to Gothenburg.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: So how was the tour? The audiences, do you remember anything about that tour? How you were received?

Well it started in Copenhagen. We played at this place called “The Three Crowns Hotel Auditorium”. We were there for a couple of days and we went to Stockholm. There we played in the Kungsträdgården and there were over 50,000 people there!
Just J.J.! That must have been an exhilarating experience going out there in front of 50,000 people.
You go out there and you think, “You better not drop a stick tonight!” (Laughs)
Who else was in that group?
Tommy Flanagan, Wilbur Little, and Bobby Jaspar. You know a Belgian saxophonist, and of course J.J
So you went all throughout Scandinavia?

We mostly stayed in Sweden. Have you heard of the folk parks they have there? In every little village or town there is a—its sort of what they would call in England, the commons- so they have all the entertainment there. We played a concert there and then a dance and mosquitoes were all over me! I said, “I got to get some oil!” That was a riot. But we were there for three months. We went all the way from Kiruna up in the Lapland to Gothenburg.
Wow, a three-month tour? Then you went to back to the states after that?
Cause this is bringing us to the close of ’57 when we have another landmark recording coming up.
